teaser: "You go first." Someone says it to you at the voting line, waving you ahead though you were not first in it. You are a 1, the number of the one who starts, and an ENTP, the type that cannot leave an idea unexamined. The two do not simply add up to boldness. Starting comes easy; staying inside what gets started asks a different kind of nerve, since the same mind that reaches for the lead also wants to argue with it. What looks like leadership from outside can be the newest idea you have decided, for now, to call a plan.
